extracted.intended_audience: registrants, corporate accountants, securities lawyers, and financial reporting teams preparing SEC registration statements and proxy materials (business-combination transactions)
extracted.subtask_description: Interpretive guidance on which acquired-business financial statements must be included, updated, or may be omitted in SEC registration statements and proxy materials under S‑X Rule 3‑05 and related S‑X and Form rules (including age, updating, significance thresholds, and timing exceptions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Age of financial statements for non‑Form 10 filings (S‑X Rule 8‑08)
rubrics_metrics.description: At the date of filing, financial statements included in filings other than filings on Form 10-K must be not less current than the financial statements that would be required in Forms 10-K and 10-Q if such reports were required to be filed; if required financial statements are as of a date 135 days or more before the date a registration statement becomes effective or proxy material is expected to be mailed, the financial statements shall be updated to include financial statements for an interim period ending within 135 days of the effective or expected mailing date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interim financial statements must be prepared and presented in accordance with paragraph (b) of the rule. (Excerpt from S‑X Rule 8‑08.)

rubrics_metrics.name: 45‑day fiscal‑year‑end relief for recent fiscal year filings
rubrics_metrics.description: When the anticipated effective or mailing date falls within 45 days after the end of the fiscal year, the filing may include financial statements only as current as of the end of the third fiscal quarter; provided, however, that if the audited financial statements for the recently completed fiscal year are available or become available before effectiveness or mailing, they must be included in the filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If audited financial statements are not included because not yet available, the filing shall be updated with such audited financial statements if they become available prior to the anticipated effective date or proposed mailing date (proxy statements). (S‑X Rule 8‑08 and S‑X Rule 3‑12(b) guidance.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Smaller reporting company exception (45–90 days)
rubrics_metrics.description: If the effective date or anticipated mailing date falls after 45 days but within 90 days of the end of the smaller reporting company's fiscal year, the smaller reporting company is not required to provide the audited financial statements for such year end provided the following conditions are met: (1) all reports due have been filed; (2) for the most recent fiscal year for which audited financial statements are not yet available, the company reasonably and in good faith expects to report income from continuing operations before taxes; and (3) for at least one of the two fiscal years immediately preceding the most recent fiscal year the company reported income from continuing operations before taxes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an exception applicable to smaller reporting companies when the filing date falls in that 45–90 day window after fiscal year‑end.

rubrics_metrics.name: Numeric day‑counts by filer type
rubrics_metrics.description: For purposes of the age calculations: (1) the number of days in paragraph (a) is 130 days for large accelerated and accelerated filers and 135 days for all other registrants; (2) for paragraph (b) the number of days is 60 days (75 days for fiscal years ending before December 15, 2006) for large accelerated filers, 75 days for accelerated filers, and 90 days for all other registrants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These numeric thresholds drive when interim or updated statements must be included or updated under S‑X rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rule 3‑05 required periods for acquired businesses
rubrics_metrics.description: A registration statement and/or proxy materials must contain the acquired business’s audited annual financial statements for the most recent fiscal year required by Rule 3‑01, unless the registration statement becomes effective (or proxy materials are to be mailed) shortly after the acquired business’s fiscal‑year end.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As of the effective/mailing date, the registrant must have on file for the acquired business a balance sheet as of an interim date ending fewer than 135 days (130 days if the acquired business is an accelerated filer) and the income statement and statement of cash flows through the interim balance sheet date. [S‑X Rule 3‑12, S‑X Rule 8‑08]

rubrics_metrics.name: Updating Rule 3‑05 financial statements when effectiveness is delayed (135+ days)
rubrics_metrics.description: If a registration statement becomes effective (or the proxy materials are mailed) 135 or more days after the acquisition date, a registrant must provide updated financial statements for the significant acquired business as of the end of the last pre‑acquisition fiscal year or the last pre‑acquisition interim period, whichever is later, and the comparative prior fiscal year and interim period depending on significance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The update requirement exists because the effective or mailing date is ordinarily weeks or months after initial filing and initial financial statements may have become stale. (See Question 4.4.40.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Age determination when proxy materials are included
rubrics_metrics.description: When a registration statement also includes proxy materials that will be mailed, the age of the acquired‑business financial statements is determined by reference to the proxy mailing date; where no proxy will be mailed, the effective date of the registration statement is used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If mailing is delayed and not within a few days of the effective date, the age of Rule 3‑05 financial statements required in the proxy materials needs to be based on the mailing date. [FRM 1220.8]

rubrics_metrics.name: Omission of Rule 3‑05 pre‑acquisition statements when operations included in registrant consolidated statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Rule 3‑05 pre‑acquisition financial statements of an acquired business may be omitted if the acquired business’s operations have been included in the registrant’s audited consolidated financial statements for nine months or a complete fiscal year, depending on the acquisition’s level of significance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Significance thresholds: greater than 20% but not 40% → 9 months; greater than 40% → a complete fiscal year. If operations have not been included for the relevant period, the registrant must provide the audited pre‑acquisition financial statements required by the significance thresholds. However, the acquired business’s balance sheet may be omitted if the acquisition is reflected in the registrant’s latest balance sheet in the filing. [S‑X Rule 3‑05(b)(4)(iii)–(iv)]

rubrics_metrics.name: Acquisitions within 74 days before effectiveness/mailing (50% significance test)
rubrics_metrics.description: Registration and proxy statements may omit the financial statements of businesses acquired within 74 days before the effective date of a registration statement or mailing date of proxy material, if the acquisition is less than 50% significant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When omitted under this exception, the registrant must subsequently file those financial statements and any pro forma information on Form 8‑K/A no later than 75 days after consummation. The exception also applies to individual probable acquisitions that are 50% or less significant and to completed acquisitions tested in the aggregate. [S‑X Rule 3‑05(b)(4)(i), FRM 2045.17]

rubrics_metrics.name: Cannot use post‑acquisition consolidated statements to shorten pre‑acquisition requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: A registrant’s post‑acquisition financial statements (which include results of the acquired business) cannot be used in lieu of the acquired business’s pre‑acquisition financial statements to reduce the periods that audited pre‑acquisition statements must cover.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exception: if the acquired business has been included in the registrant’s post‑acquisition consolidated financial statements for a sufficient period (based on significance thresholds), separate Rule 3‑05 statements may not be required. Combining pre‑ and post‑acquisition periods to satisfy the requirements requires a waiver from the SEC staff. [SEC Rel. 33‑10786]

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing date and effectiveness/mailing date both matter for age compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: The age of financial statements must comply with S‑X Rule 3‑12 or Rule 8‑08 at the date the registration statement or proxy material is filed with the SEC and at the date the registration statement becomes effective or the proxy material is mailed to shareholders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If financial statements included in a filing do not comply with the age requirements at the time of filing, the SEC staff may decline to review/process the document or request withdrawal until it can be filed with fully compliant financial statements. If the delay between filing and effectiveness/mailing crosses dates that require more recent statements, updating may be necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registrant vs acquired business filing status effects
rubrics_metrics.description: Rule 3‑05 financial statement age requirements are the same regardless of the registrant’s filing status (accelerated/non‑accelerated); however, the filing status of the acquired business is relevant when determining the age of Rule 3‑05 financial statements and can result in mismatched financial statement periods in the filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: an accelerated filer registrant acquiring a non‑accelerated acquired business may have more current registrant statements than those required by Rule 3‑05 for the acquired business. [FRM 2045.5]

rubrics_metrics.name: When audited financial statements are considered 'available'
rubrics_metrics.description: Determining what constitutes 'available' financial statements depends on facts and circumstances; under Topic 855 (subsequent events), financial statements are considered available no later than when they are issued.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If audited financial statements become available before effectiveness/mailing, they must be included or the filing must be updated. (Question 4.4.110 guidance.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Separate audited balance sheet omission when registrant balance sheet post‑dates acquisition
rubrics_metrics.description: A separate audited balance sheet of the acquired business is not required when the registrant's most recent audited balance sheet required by §210.3‑01 is for a date after the date the acquisition was consummated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Limited exceptions apply; see S‑X Rule 3‑05(b)(4)(iv) for details.
